01 / Our story

The story of us.

In our own words, for the person we choose every day.

His words

To my wife.

“You loved me when I was still becoming.”

Read his letter

I still remember meeting you in 2020. Back then, I had so many dreams but very little figured out. Yet, you saw something in me that I was still trying to see in myself.

You stayed through the uncertain days, celebrated my little wins, and reminded me that I was capable of becoming the man I dreamed of being.

Today, seeing you in your wedding dress, I wish I could take you back to those days and show you how far we’ve come.

You loved me when I was still becoming. And I promise to spend the rest of my life loving you through every version of yourself, just as you loved me through mine.

If I had to start all over again, with nothing but a dream and the hope of finding you, I’d do it all again.

Thank you for being my yesterday, my today, and every tomorrow I pray for.

Forever yours,
Your husband.

Her words

To my husband.

“Today, I choose you. Tomorrow, I’ll choose you again.”

Read her letter

When I met you in 2020, I didn’t know you would become my answered prayer. I only knew there was something about you that made me want to stay and discover the man behind your dreams.

I saw your potential, but more importantly, I saw your heart. I saw the man you were becoming, and I wanted to be there for the journey.

We’ve grown, we’ve learned, and we’ve come so far. And today, I get to marry the man I once prayed our story would lead me to.

I don’t expect a perfect life with you. I want a real one. The quiet mornings, the difficult days, the laughter, the little arguments, the dreams we’ll build, and the beautiful privilege of growing old together.

If life gave me a thousand chances to choose my person, I would still look for you.

Today, I choose you. Tomorrow, I’ll choose you again.

Forever your wife.

Before you join us.

A few details to help you plan.

How do I let you know I am coming?

Use “RSVP” at the bottom of the screen. Replies can be sent once the private guest service is connected. A WhatsApp confirmation option appears if a confirmed contact is configured.

Where will we be celebrating?

Our sample traditional ceremony, white wedding and reception are in Lagos. Open each event in “Three days. A lifetime.” for the time, venue and map. These venues and maps are placeholders.

What should I wear?

Champagne and gold asoebi for the traditional day, formal soft neutrals for the white wedding, and black tie with a touch of gold for the reception. Gele and coral beads are warmly welcome for the traditional celebration. These styling details are samples.

May I bring someone with me?

Please include an additional guest only if your invitation names them or includes a plus one. Use the guest count to tell us your party size.

Can family abroad use this invitation?

Yes. Family and friends can use the same link wherever they are. All ceremony times shown here are West Africa Time (UTC+1). Add the events to your calendar to see them in your own time zone.

How can I send a gift?

Tap “Send a Gift” in the bottom bar for the bank details and registry. The account details are samples: please do not send money. Gift reservations open when the private guest service is connected.

With love,

Chioma & Henry
